pages.title: Einlass (tab title only; the page renders no PageHeader)
pages.purpose: Door mode for one event: scan QR codes (tickets + member cards), sell at the door, look up tickets, members and guest-list entries and let them in.
pages.permission: tickets.scan (module tickets) or guestlists.checkin (module guestlists); notFound otherwise

header.notes: No <PageHeader>: no title, crumbs, gear, menu or primary. The event chips are the first thing on the page.

urlState.meaning: event id; default = first published event starting within the last 12 h or later (list: published, from 7 days ago, max 20)
scan | sale | tickets | members | guests (only those permitted; default = first)
search on the Gäste / Tickets / Mitglieder tabs
guest list filter on the Gäste tab
contact id of the member card shown on the Mitglieder tab

sections.title: Event wählen
sections.notes: Empty: 'Keine veröffentlichten Events in den letzten Tagen oder demnächst.' (tickets.noEventsToScan).

sections.title: DoorStats
sections.notes: tickets.scan only. Collapsible card (button): Eingelassen n / expected, Offen, Noch verkaufbar (∞ / ausverkauft, red < 10) + progress bar. Expanded: table per kind (shop types, Gästeliste, Mitglieder) with 'eingelassen / erwartet' and 'noch frei' / 'online noch frei', row 'davon Abendkasse'. Refreshes on door:changed, online, timer.

sections.title: Tabs (Einlass-Ansichten)
sections.notes: Scannen · Verkauf · Tickets (tickets.scan) · Mitglieder (tickets.scan + members module) · Gäste (guestlists.checkin). Phones: fixed bottom tab bar (data-own-tab-bar, App bar hides, icons + labels, 56px). From md: segmented bar inline.

sections.title: Tab Scannen

fields.name: camera
fields.label: Kamera starten / Kamera stoppen
fields.notes: state remembered on the device (localStorage roots-scan-camera); BarcodeDetector or jsQR

sections.notes: Status line: offline badge, 'n Tickets auf dem Gerät, Stand hh:mm', queued check-ins, refresh icon button (tickets.refreshList), sync note (synced / conflicts). Result box: 'Gültig – Einlass' / 'Schon eingecheckt' (+ time) / 'Ungültig' / 'Fehler' with code, holder, type. Member code → MemberCard with 'Einlassen' button (second step). Offline: list and members cached in localStorage, check-ins queued.

sections.title: Tab Verkauf

fields.name: free
fields.label: Freier Betrag
fields.component: dashed tile → inline form: Betrag (TypedInput:money), Anzahl (− / +), Hinzufügen / Abbrechen

fields.name: buyer.email
fields.label: E-Mail
fields.notes: hint door.sale.buyerHint: tickets mailed + contact created

sections.notes: Phases: cart → cash (given/change) | waiting (QR code or 'Bitte am Kartenterminal bezahlen', polls every 2 s) → done ('Bezahlt', 'n Tickets eingelassen', 'Nächster Verkauf') | failed (retry with any method / cancel). Capacity line 'Noch n Plätze frei' or red 'Über der Kapazität … – Verkauf ist trotzdem möglich.' Offline: only cash, sales queued on the device. Below: card 'Abendkasse heute' with 'n Verkäufe · n Tickets', total per method, Summe.

sections.title: Tab Tickets

sections.title: Tab Mitglieder
sections.notes: Results as link rows (name, 'Nr. …') → ?who=<id>; MemberCard (status, membership state, paused, overdue dues, full, visits, last visit) with 'Einlassen'. Empty 'Kein Mitglied gefunden.'

sections.title: Tab Gäste

fields.name: list
fields.label: Alle Listen + one chip per list

pages.empty: 'Keine veröffentlichten Events in den letzten Tagen oder demnächst.' and no tabs; Verkauf without methods: 'Für diese Veranstaltung ist keine Zahlungsart an der Tür aktiv (Tickets → Abendkasse).'
pages.phone: Designed phone-first: own bottom tab bar (App MobileBar hidden), 44–56px buttons, big search boxes, pb-24 for the bar; camera square full width.
uxNotes: No PageHeader: the page has no visible title and the top bar gets no area/page label from the page itself; every other App page uses <PageHeader>.
Door settings (methods, terminal, cash book account) live on Events › <event> › Tickets (#door), not here; the empty-methods hint points there in text only ('Tickets → Abendkasse'), without a link.
Check-in labels drift: 'Einchecken' (scanner submit), 'Einlass' (row buttons), 'Einlassen' (members), result 'Gültig – Einlass'; status 'Eingecheckt' vs 'drin seit'.
Guest-list chip filter is hand-built and placed right (justify-self-end) under the search, unlike other toolbars.
'Rückgängig' on a guest check-in has no confirm (low risk); the cash sale 'Bar erhalten' books money and lets people in without a confirm by design.
Events older than 7 days or drafts cannot be selected; a cancelled event never shows (status filter = published).
Two distinct feedback styles on one page: scanner/sale show inline result boxes, the list tabs reload with toasts.

redesign.job: Get people in fast and right: scan, sell at the door, look someone up, know how full it is.
redesign.phone: Scanner app: header (Einlass + gear), event chips, live numbers, one view at a time via the bottom tab bar (Scannen · Verkauf · Tickets · Mitglieder · Gäste); big result box; door cash under Verkauf.
redesign.desktop: Door dashboard without a tab bar: live numbers full width (rows per type open), left = action panel (Scannen · Verkauf segments + door cash of the night), right = lookup panel (Tickets · Gäste · Mitglieder segments, ?look=).
moves: no PageHeader → PageHeader area=events 'Einlass' with gear → /events/<id>/tickets?edit=settings#door (tickets.manage)
DoorStats → full width above the panels on every view
tab bar (phone + md segmented) → phone bottom bar only; desktop: two Segments (actions, lookups)
Verkauf tab → action panel 'Verkauf'; 'Abendkasse heute' summary → DoorCash (phone: under Verkauf; desktop: always under the action panel)
Tickets / Mitglieder / Gäste tabs → lookup panel
guest list chip nav → FilterMenu 'Liste' next to the search
empty-methods hint → hint + link 'Abendkasse einrichten' to the settings
labels Einlass/Einlassen → Einchecken; 'Eingelassen' → 'Eingecheckt'; toast '{name} ist eingecheckt.'
Rückgängig on guest check-in → kept without confirm (one tap undo, low risk)
camera auto-start → only when the scanner is visible

sweep.note: Checked phone (own tab bar, event chips, stats, camera, code field) + desktop (two columns): fine. 'drin seit …' badges now success instead of default black. Found: 'online noch frei 0' in red for types without quota = the ticket_availability DB bug (backlog §Z).
